verdict.rationale: The privacy-posture axis applies to a hosted model/API platform like DeepSeek. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any setting or control for opting out of telemetry, usage tracking, or data use. The only on-topic item is a community note that OpenRouter lists DeepSeek as a provider that may use prompts and completions for training, which suggests there is no opt-out but does not document one either way.
